fee_notes: No traditional royalty % or marketing %. Instead: Transaction Fee $50-$400/side (capped $2,700/yr/rep); Regional Development Fee $35/side (capped $500/yr/rep); Company Development Fee 10% of gross commissions (capped $10,000/yr/rep); Annual Membership $425/person; Renewal Fee 10-15% of then-current Initial Fee. All fees subject to 7% annual increase.
raw_excerpt: Computer Software Fee $250 Monthly; Transaction Fee $50-$400 per transaction side, not to exceed $2,700 per year per Sales Representative; Regional Development Fee $35 per transaction side, not to exceed $500 per year per Sales Representative; Company Development Fee Equivalent to 10% of the gross commissions generated per year by every Sales Representative to a maximum cumulative fee of $10,000 per calendar year
